Excellent communication and customer service skills.

Willingness to work exclusively during night shifts to provide 24/7 customer support.

If you are a dedicated and skilled technician with a background in computer science and a passion for providing exceptional helpdesk support, we encourage you to apply. Please send your resume and a cover letter to hr@ankabut.af with the subject line "Helpdesk Technician (Night Shift) Application - [Your Name]." Ankabut ISP is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds to join our team.

new_jobs.title: Pediatrician
new_jobs.description:
About Bakhter Development Network - BDN
Bakhter Development Network (BDN) was established and registered in 2001 with the Ministry of Economics in Afghanistan as an Afghan, non-political, non-profit, and non-governmental organization. BDN operates in line with its constitution in three sectors: education, health, and agriculture and livestock. With its current focus on public health and nutrition services, BDN's mission is to assist communities in the achievement of their own development goals, while its vision is a world of enabled communities working toward a brighter future.
Currently, BDN is involved in implementing different health projects across multiple provinces of Afghanistan, such as BPHS-EPHS projects in Balkh and vertical projects like CBNI, TSFP, PHNS, FSAC, GC7, S-WIFS, and RMNCAH/SRH and PSS services in provinces such as Balkh, Badakhshan, Baghlan, Faryab, Sar-e-Pol, Jawzjan, Samangan, Takhar, Kapisa, Ghazni, Kunduz, Paktia, Paktika, Khost, Kabul, Parwan, Panjshir, and Maidan Wardak.
BDN, in more than 20 years of its operation, has made impressive contributions in promoting access to quality healthcare and has developed a reputable track record in the effective implementation of numerous projects within the country. BDN adheres to the policy of equal employment opportunities, and its hiring process is based on evaluation by knowledge, skill, work experience, and ability, without regard to age, sex, race, religion, ethnicity, or physical status.

Job Descriptions
Objective:
The pediatric specialist is responsible for identifying and treating emergency patients, particularly those with urgent and complex cases. They are also responsible for diagnosing diseases and recommending medications at the hospital.
Key Responsibilities:
Conducted examinations; diagnosed; and treated pediatric patients, including those with infectious diseases, in accordance with the standards set by the Ministry of Public Health, including comprehensive childhood illness treatments.
Identify and report issues that interfere with healthcare services.
Identify and hospitalize emergency and complicated pediatric cases.
Complete patient files by taking medical histories, conducting physical examinations, and prescribing treatments according to disease diagnosis based on standard guidelines.
Monitor hospitalized patients during their stay based on progress notes.
Hospitalize patients with moderate acute malnutrition (MAM) and severe acute malnutrition (SAM) and diagnose and treat malnutrition-related diseases.
Participate in training sessions provided by the implementing organization.
Attend hospital monthly meetings and committees as required.
Refer patients to other well-equipped centers for further examination and treatment based on diagnosis.
Maintain the registration book, referral forms, and discharge letters, and ensure continuous documentation of patient diagnoses, medication recommendations, and referrals to higher centers, along with other necessary advice during examinations.
Collaborate with all departments of the health center, including providing practical training.
Perform specialized procedures for patients in need and train junior doctors in these procedures.
Possess sufficient knowledge of Afghanistan’s Basic Package of Health Services (BPHS) and implement it in practice.
Adhere to night duty shifts based on the monthly duty roster.
Carry out additional tasks assigned by the relevant supervisor or organization officials.

Job Requirements
A specialty degree in pediatrics from a recognized entity is required.
At least 5 years of experience in the field.
Prior experience in a similar role is an advantage.
Strong communication skills.
Proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing Dari, Pashto, and English.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel is essential.
Demonstrated organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively under pressure and take initiative.
Integrity and a strong commitment to organizational goals are essential.

Submission Guidelines
We welcome prospective applicants to submit their resumes and a formal letter of application delineating their credentials and enthusiasm for the role via the provided link until the close of business on the mentioned deadline. Please note that applicants may submit only one application for their chosen position.

BDN also adheres to strict child-safeguarding principles. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to these standards and principles and will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks. Background checks will include the verification of academic credentials and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.

Role Summary
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Software Developer to join our growing technology team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining secure, scalable, and high-quality software applications.
The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Python-based backend development and modern frontend technologies such as Vue.js or React. The role requires close collaboration with business analysts, requirement teams, DevOps engineers, and other developers to deliver reliable software solutions that meet organizational and business requirements.
Experience with ERPNext and the Frappe Framework will be considered a strong advantage .

Duties and Responsibilities
· Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain web-based software applications.
· Develop secure and scalable backend services and APIs using Python.
· Build responsive and user-friendly frontend interfaces using Vue.js or React.
· Translate business and functional requirements into technical solutions.
· Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services.
· Design and maintain application databases, data models, and database queries.
· Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well-documented code.
· Participate in software architecture and technical design discussions.
· Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues.
· Optimize application performance, database queries, and API response times.
· Apply software security best practices, including authentication, authorization, validation, and secure data handling.
· Use Git and standard version-control workflows for source-code management.
· Participate in code reviews and ensure compliance with coding standards.
· Write unit tests, integration tests, and other automated tests where required.
· Work closely with the requirement team to ensure successful implementation of business requirements.
· Support application deployment, configuration, upgrades, and production maintenance.
· Investigate production incidents and participate in root-cause analysis.
· Prepare and maintain technical documentation, API documentation, database documentation, and user guides.
· Participate in Agile activities such as sprint planning, daily stand-up meetings, task estimation, and retrospectives.
· Provide technical support and guidance when required.
· Continuously research and adopt appropriate technologies, frameworks, and development practices.

Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.
At least 2 years of professional software-development experience.
Strong programming experience with Python.
Experience with Python frameworks such as Django, Flask, FastAPI, Frappe, or similar frameworks.
Practical experience with either Vue.js or React.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript, Typescript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software-design principles.
Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MySQL, or SQL Server.

new_jobs.description:
Role Summary
• The IT Product & Service Delivery Engineer is responsible for the successful delivery, integration, implementation, and operational support of ATOMA Pay digital financial services. The role ensures new products, enhancements, and integrations are delivered on time while maintaining high service availability, security, and operational excellence. The engineer serves as the technical bridge between business stakeholders, development teams, vendors, and external partners throughout the product lifecycle, while also designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and continuously improving the underlying platforms and integrations that support ATOMA Pay services.

Duties and Responsibilities
• Coordinate the end-to-end delivery of new ATOMA Pay products, services, enhancements, and production releases, ensuring timely and successful implementation.
• Design, configure, implement, and support technical solutions, system integrations, and application deployments for ATOMA Pay platforms.
• Analyze business and technical requirements, translate them into technical solutions, and collaborate with architecture and development teams to ensure scalable and secure implementations
• Prepare implementation plans, deployment plans, rollback procedures, cutover plans, and go-live checklists to ensure controlled and successful releases.
• Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), technical validation, and production readiness, obtaining required business approvals before deployment.
• Manage production releases, change requests, and deployment activities in accordance with change management and release management processes.
• Coordinate and support API integrations with banks, payment switches, mobile network operators, fintech partners, and other third-party service providers.
• Monitor production applications, APIs, and infrastructure to ensure high availability, performance, and compliance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Troubleshoot application, integration, and production issues, ensuring timely resolution and minimal business impact.
• Coordinate incident, problem, and change management activities, perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement preventive and corrective actions.
• Perform system integration, configuration, end-to-end testing, and production readiness verification for new products and enhancements.
• Support application configuration, deployment, patch management, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation activities.
• Implement and maintain operational automation for deployments, monitoring, and routine support activities to improve efficiency and service reliability.
• Support disaster recovery planning, business continuity, backup validation, and disaster recovery testing to ensure service resilience.
• Perform system health checks, performance monitoring, capacity planning, and performance tuning to optimize platform stability and scalability.
• Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including SOPs, MOPs, runbooks, architecture diagrams, interface specifications, release notes, and operational reports.
• Collaborate closely with Business, Operations, Finance, Compliance, Information Security, Infrastructure, Development teams, vendors, and external partners throughout the product lifecycle.
• Ensure compliance with security policies, operational standards, regulatory requirements, and IT governance frameworks.
• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, process optimization, and technology enhancements to improve service quality, operational efficiency, and customer experience.
• Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and operational support to internal teams and stakeholders as required

Job Requirements
Education:
Bachelor of Computer Sciences (BCS) / Information Technology or equivalent
Knowledge of SDLC, ITIL, and Change Management processes.
Experience:
ü 3–5 years of experience in Product Delivery, Service Delivery, Digital Payments, FinTech, or Telecom.
ü Digital wallets and mobile money
ü Payment gateways
ü Banking integrations
ü Third-party service integrations
ü Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity
ü Information Security best practices

new_jobs.description:
About Yama Ramin Media Production & Technology (YRMPT)
Yama Ramin Media Production and Technology Company (YRMPT) is a well-established media production and technology company, officially registered with the Ministry of Commerce and Industries of Afghanistan. With a strong presence across the country, YRMPT delivers innovative media and technology solutions in collaboration with a diverse range of national and international organizations.
We work closely with leading telecom operators, as well as international NGOs, development partners, and humanitarian organizations, and various United Nations agencies. Our projects span media production, digital solutions, communication campaigns, and technology-driven services, contributing to impactful and sustainable initiatives nationwide.
At YRMPT, we value professionalism, creativity, innovation, and teamwork. We provide a dynamic working environment that encourages learning, skill development, and growth, while offering opportunities to work on high-impact projects with reputable local and international partners.
For more information about our company, services, and portfolio, please visit www.yrmpt.com .

Job Descriptions
Position Summary
The Junior Motion Graphic Designer will support the creative and production teams in designing and producing motion graphics, animations, video edits, and visual content for digital and broadcast platforms. This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates or early-career professionals to develop their skills while working on diverse and exciting projects under the guidance of experienced creatives.
Key Responsibilities
Motion Graphics & Animation
Assist in designing and producing motion graphics, 2D animations, and visual effects for commercials, social media, corporate videos, documentaries, promotional films, and awareness campaigns.
Create engaging animated content for digital marketing campaigns, presentations, websites, and multimedia projects under supervision of senior motion graphic designers.
Animate logos, titles, typography, infographics, and other visual elements.
Assist in editing video content using industry-standard software.
Apply basic motion graphics, transitions, visual effects, color correction, and audio synchronization.
Ensure assigned tasks are completed on time and meet quality standards.

Job Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Multimedia, Animation, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field.
Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
Up to 1 year of experience through internships, freelance work, academic projects, or personal portfolio is an advantage.
Basic to intermediate proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
Familiarity with Blender or Cinema 4D is an advantage but not required.
Strong willingness to learn, adapt, and grow in a fast-paced creative environment.
